title: Fork in the Bill: routing experiment
description: Live cost, latency and progress per Flagsmith arm, from OpenTelemetry spans in ClickHouse.

list.name: experiment
list.label: Experiment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT SpanAttributes['fib.experiment'] FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE SpanName = 'fib.task' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Spend per arm (cumulative USD)
panels.description: Running total of priced model-call cost (fib.usd) per Flagsmith variant, from model-call spans.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS time, variant, sum(usd) OVER (PARTITION BY variant ORDER BY t) AS usd
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS t,
         SpanAttributes['fib.variant'] AS variant,
         sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['fib.usd'])) AS usd
  FROM otel.otel_traces
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['fib.lane'] != '' AND SpanAttributes['fib.experiment'] IN (${experiment:singlequote})
  GROUP BY t, variant
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: p95 model-call latency per lane
panels.description: 95th percentile span duration of model calls, split by main and delegate lane.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time,
       SpanAttributes['fib.lane'] AS lane,
       quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p95_seconds
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['fib.lane'] != '' AND SpanAttributes['fib.experiment'] IN (${experiment:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, lane
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Delegate share of cost per arm
panels.description: Delegate-lane USD divided by all model-call USD, per variant.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['fib.variant'] AS variant,
       sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['fib.usd']), SpanAttributes['fib.lane'] = 'delegate')
         / nullIf(sum(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['fib.usd'])), 0) AS delegate_share
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanAttributes['fib.lane'] != '' AND SpanAttributes['fib.experiment'] IN (${experiment:singlequote})
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY variant

panels.title: Tasks done per arm
panels.description: Finished task spans per variant, and how many were solved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['fib.variant'] AS variant,
       count() AS done,
       countIf(SpanAttributes['fib.solved'] = 'true') AS solved
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanName = 'fib.task' AND SpanAttributes['fib.experiment'] IN (${experiment:singlequote})
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY variant
